$comment: EDE-273 (#EDE-241 P6.1, 2026-11-27): SYSTEM SETTINGS, Mint's cinnamon-settings on eDE. ONE window of the shell (apps/ede/ui/settings.express, a `window` surface: a normal toplevel with eDE's frame and its own taskbar entry, app id at.exponential.settings, a single instance: asked again it comes to the front; closed from its frame, the next open starts on the grid). `title` = the window's title on the grid. `categories` = the grid's sections in order (Cinnamon's Appearance, Preferences, Hardware, then Exponential, then Administration). `modules` = THE catalogue, in each category's order (Cinnamon's: by name; Exponential's own order): {id (the module's route segment: `~/settings/<id>`), name (the tile's label AND the window's title while it is open, Cinnamon's wording), category, icon (a concept of packages/icons), keywords (Cinnamon's keyword list plus eDE's, comma separated: the search reads them), kind: module (a page in the window) | later (listed honestly, its page says it is not built yet) | launch (Mint's own tool: `command` runs, the window stays where it was), opens? (an alias: Account Details and Online Accounts open Exponential's Account), tabs? (#EDE-274: the module's stack switcher in the header, cinnamon-settings' pages of one module, [{value, label}] in order)}. `aliases` = the page ids links used before #EDE-273 (the applets, the panel menu, a person's documents) and the module they mean. SELECTORS: settingsGrid(query, installed) -> [{id, title, modules [{id, name, icon, kind, later (kind is later), installed (a launch module: its id is in `installed`, the launch modules whose command the host finds; every other kind true)}]}]: q = query trimmed and lowercased; empty = every module; else a module is listed when its name (lowercased) or its keywords (lowercased) CONTAIN q (Cinnamon's filter_visible_function), and a category with no listed module is left out. settingsNavigate(state, event, installed) -> {state, launch, title}: state = {module (`` = the grid), query (as typed), tab (the open module's page of its stack, `` without one)}; launch = a command to run or null; title = the open module's name, else `title`. EVENTS: open {id} (a tile's press): an unknown id changes nothing; an alias resolves to its target; a launch module whose tool is installed launches (state unchanged), else (not installed) its page opens; any other module opens (module = its id, tab = its first page or ``, the query kept for back). back (the header's back button, Alt+Left): in a module the grid again (tab ``), query kept, and the keyboard back in the search; on the grid nothing. query {text}: on the grid the search text (it filters live); in a module ignored (the search is the grid's). submit (Enter in the search): on the grid with a non-empty trimmed query, `open` of the FIRST module settingsGrid lists; no match, an empty query or a module open: nothing. link {target} (`~/settings/<module>` from the start menu's search, a link, an applet; `~/settings` alone or a bare id too; an old page id through `aliases`): the query cleared; an unknown target = the grid; a launch module with its tool launches and the window shows the grid; else that module on its first page. tab {value} (#EDE-274, the stack switcher): a page the open module lists becomes `tab`; another value, or on the grid, nothing. Any other event changes nothing. The WINDOW: the header carries the back button and the module's name while a module is open (and its stack switcher, a Segmented, centred) and the search on the grid (focused whenever the grid shows); Enter in the search = submit; tiles are 104 px wide with a 48 px icon disc and the name under it (a later module's name muted); a module's page is a centred column (640 px) of framed groups (a title, then a bordered box of rows divided by hairlines). A setting the machine cannot apply yet is a read-only value row, never a dead control.

grid.name: no query: every category in Cinnamon's order plus Exponential before Administration, every module
a name matches as a substring, case-blind: 'sou' finds Sound, System Info (its keyword sound) and Software Sources
a keyword matches: 'wifi' finds Network and Driver Manager
the query is trimmed and lowercased
an Exponential module by keyword: 'claude' finds Agents
a launch module whose tool is missing is still listed, not installed

navigate.name: open a module from the grid: its page, the window titled by it
open keeps the query for back
an alias opens its target: Account Details is Exponential's Account
Online Accounts is Exponential's Account too
an unknown module changes nothing
a later module opens its honest page
a launch module with its tool installed launches it and stays on the grid
a launch module without its tool opens its page (not installed)
back from a module returns to the grid with the query kept
back on the grid changes nothing
typing in the search on the grid stores the text as typed
a query in a module is ignored
Enter opens the first match in grid order
Enter with no match changes nothing
Enter with an empty query changes nothing
Enter on a launch module launches it
Enter in a module changes nothing
a link ~/settings/<module> opens it with the query cleared
a bare module id is a link too
an old page id still lands: datetime is Date & Time
an old page id: defaults is Preferred Applications
a link to an alias lands on its target
a link to a launch module with its tool launches it, the window on the grid
~/settings alone is the grid
an unknown link is the grid
a module with a stack opens on its first page
the stack switcher picks a page of the open module
a page the module does not have changes nothing
the stack switcher on the grid changes nothing
back leaves the module's page too
a link to a module with a stack opens its first page
an unknown event changes nothing
